The UN Special Rapporteur on the Occupied Palestinian Territories, **Francesca
Albanese,** made headlines this week after a doctored video from an interview
of hers prompted governments across Europe to call for her resignation. The
video, which falsely depicts the UN official describing Israel as humanity's
"common enemy," went viral, with Albanese calling for a "serious
investigation" in its wake.
